On Mon, 2026-12-06 at 09:12, laura_bennett wrote:
> I will finalize runbook v1 and share a Drive link by Mon 12/7 11:00 PST.

Short technical update: the quantized-kernel path introduces a subtle cache-warm behavior for long prefixes. Our QA signals on smaller seq lengths look fine, but full-prod traffic (longer prompts, embeddings-heavy customers) shows a ~0.4% regeneration rate during first 24h.

Recommendation and exception request:
- Extend canary window from 24h -> 72h for the first rollout to allow KV cache warm and low-frequency degradation to surface.
- During the extended canary, we run an A/B sampling on 5% traffic and block outbound changes to routing/pinning unless regression < 0.1% per hour.
- Rollback criteria (proposed): 1) token error rate > 0.5% sustained for 30m OR 2) customer-facing latency P95 regresses > 30% vs baseline.

Attachment: [canary-matrix.xlsx] with monitoring metrics and alert thresholds.

If we get agreement from Product/Revenue/Legal on the extension, Ops is ready to schedule the longer canary. Otherwise we'll need to push the date by 1–2 weeks.

—Dev
Infra/Serving Engineer
Redwood Inference
